title.en: Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (School Uniformed Corps — Exemption) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Guns, Explosives and Weapons Control (School Uniformed Corps — Exemption) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 1 July 2025.

heading.en: Licence not needed for NPCC member

text.en:
3.—(1) An NPCC member is exempt from the requirement in sections 11, 21 and 22 of the Act to be authorised by a licence for having in his or her possession or for using a gun or any ammunition for that gun, when engaging in any activity —
(a)as an NPCC cadet; and
(b)under the direct supervision and in accordance with the directions of —
(i)an NPCC officer; and
(ii)a responsible police officer.
(2) An NPCC officer is exempt from the requirement in sections 11, 21 and 22 of the Act to be authorised by a licence for having in his or her possession or for using a gun or any ammunition for that gun, when engaging in any activity, or in the course of discharging his or her duties —
(a)as an NPCC officer; and
(b)under the direct supervision and in accordance with the directions of a responsible police officer.

heading.en: Licence not needed for NCC member

text.en:
4.—(1) An NCC member is exempt from the requirement in sections 11, 21 and 22 of the Act to be authorised by a licence for having in his or her possession or for using a gun or any ammunition for that gun, when engaging in any activity —
(a)as an NCC cadet; and
(b)under the direct supervision and in accordance with the directions of —
(i)an NCC officer; and
(ii)a responsible military officer.
(2) An NCC officer is exempt from the requirement in sections 11, 21 and 22 of the Act to be authorised by a licence for having in his or her possession or for using a gun or any ammunition for that gun, when engaging in any activity, or in the course of discharging his or her duties —
(a)as an NCC officer; and
(b)under the direct supervision and in accordance with the directions of a responsible military officer.
